name: Dilatación Pupilar
description: Analiza la dilatación pupilar para detectar anomalías de deepfake
mechanism:
This method analyzes pupil dilation dynamics for deepfake detection:

1. **Pupila Seguimiento**: Precise pupil boundaries are tracked per frame using circular Hough transform or ellipse fitting. Pupil diameter is measured relative to iris diameter (to normalize for distance/zoom changes). The pupil-to-iris ratio temporal signal is extracted.

2. **Lighting - Pupila Correlación**: Pupil diameter should inversely correlate with ambient light level — brighter environment → smaller pupils. The method measures scene luminance and checks the pupil-light correlation. In deepfakes, generated pupil sizes may not respond to scene illumination changes.

3. **Dilation Dynamics**: Pupil dilation/constriction follows specific temporal dynamics: constriction is faster (~0.5s) than dilation (~1s), with characteristic latency (~250ms). The method verifies that observed pupil changes follow these physiological dynamics. AI-generated pupils may show instantaneous or non-physiological size changes.

4. **Bilateral Consistencia**: Both pupils should maintain nearly equal sizes (anisocoria < 1mm in normal conditions). The method tracks left-right pupil size difference. Deepfakes frequently produce different pupil sizes in left and right eyes because each eye is generated independently.

5. **Pupila Shape Evaluación**: Real pupils are circular (round pupil margin) under normal conditions. Slight elliptical deformation occurs only at extreme gaze angles. The method checks pupil shape — AI generators may produce irregularly shaped pupils, non-circular boundaries, or pupils that change shape between frames. The combined pupil analysis provides a physiological authenticity assessment.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: sensor
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante pupil dilation analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACVW.
